verdicts.explanation: The abstract and Table V give 0.2 mS/cm at 300 K for the anion-ordered bulk, with Ea = 384 meV (Table V and Sec. III D). The computational origin (MTP MD plus Nernst-Einstein conversion, Appendix B) is correct, and the checker warning is only a formatting mismatch (384 meV = 0.384 eV).

The abstract and Table V give 29.8 mS/cm at 300 K for the 50% anion-disordered bulk, with Ea = 216 meV (Table V and Sec. III D). The computational origin is correct, and the checker warning is only a formatting mismatch (216 meV = 0.216 eV).
